newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania to name new central bank governor - sources.
newsitem.headline: Albania to name new central bank governor - sources.

text.p: The supervising board of the Bank of Albania has chosen Qamil Tusha as the new governor and a presidential decree was expected to announce the appointment later, central bank sources and newspapers said.
Central bank sources told Reuters that Tusha, who was previously deputy director of the National Commercial Bank, a state-run commercial bank, had already taken up his duties.
Official spokesmen were not immediately available.
Press reports said that the outgoing governor, Kristaq Luniku, was now working with the International Monetary Fund in Washington advising on the Albanian economy.
Albania is rebuilding its economy after an armed insurrection in late February triggered by the collapse of fraudulent savings schemes. More than 300 people have been killed in the violence.
